meta.title: End-of-turn compaction
meta.description: Compacts at 500K tokens by default. Past 80% of that threshold it waits for a good boundary: 30 quiet minutes, a completed goal, or a finished todo list. Uses the session preset's own compaction service, so the result matches /compact. Run /autocompact to see the thresholds and the last decision. Disable the plugin to fall back to the built-in policy, which compacts before a step at a fraction of the context window.
